name: MultiSelect
purpose: Lets users choose several values from a predefined list, shown as removable chips inside the field.
neverUseFor: A single value - use Select instead
A handful of options that should all stay visible - use CheckboxGroup
Free-form tags the user types - use Input
rationale: MultiSelect is a select-only combobox on a <button> plus a Menu listbox with aria-multiselectable (ADR-013, ADR-019). Chosen values appear as removable Chip s, centered 4px inside a 32px minimum field that grows downward as chips wrap — the same height as Select so both sit on one scale.

mayExtendLocally: Provide the options, label and helper text
Control the selected values from product logic
mustEscalateToDS: Adding free-text tag entry or search
Changing the chip size, field height or wrapping behavior

authored.name: disabled
authored.description: The field and its chips are non-interactive.
authored.aria: disabled (native) on the combobox and every chip

authored.name: required
authored.description: At least one value must be selected before form submission.
authored.aria: aria-required='true' on the combobox; enforced by an invisible native input, same as Select

anatomy.description: Layout wrapper for label, field, and messages.

Accessible label. Always rendered - visible or sr-only. 8px above the field (form-field-spacing pattern). Disabled: dims to text.disabled with the rest of the text (.ai/maps/patterns/disabled-state.md).

The required indicator (*) inside the label, the label color, 2px (spacing/3xs) after the text — shown by `required`. Disabled: dims to text.disabled with the rest of the text (.ai/maps/patterns/disabled-state.md).
The visible field: Select's border, fill and 32px minimum height. Holds the chips and the combobox; grows downward when the chips wrap. Clicking its empty area toggles the menu.
One dismissible Chip (size s, 24px) per selected value — 4px from the field's outer edge. Its × removes the value.
role="combobox" button filling the rest of the field. Owns real DOM focus (ADR-013/019); shows the placeholder when nothing is selected and announces the selection to assistive tech.
Trailing chevron. Flips on open, same treatment as Select.
Helper text below the field. Disabled: dims to text.disabled with the rest of the text (.ai/maps/patterns/disabled-state.md).

props.name: label
props.description: Visible or screen-reader-only label. Required for a11y.

props.name: options
props.description: List of options and grouped options.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fires with the full new array whenever a value is added or removed.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Prompt shown while nothing is selected.

props.name: description
props.description: Helper text shown below the field.

props.name: required
props.description: At least one value required; blocks native form submit while empty, like Select.

props.name: hideLabel
props.description: Hides the label visually but keeps it accessible.

props.name: id
props.description: Optional field id override (the combobox's id).

props.name: name
props.description: Native form field name; the submitted value is the selected values joined by commas.

height.note: 32px minimum, same as Select (semantic.size.m). Chip s (24px) is centered in it, 4px from the outer edge on every side. Grows downward when chips wrap (rows 4px apart) — see ADR-019.

modes.hug: Width follows the chips and placeholder, or container constraints.
modes.fixed: Explicit width set by the consumer; chips wrap inside it.

width.note: Like Select, no minimum on the field itself; the popup follows Menu's sizing.width rule (150px for word options).

a11y.role: combobox on a <button> inside the field (WAI-ARIA select-only combobox) + Menu listbox with aria-multiselectable="true" — see ADR-013 and ADR-019. Chips' × buttons are the only other focus stops.
keyboardNav: Arrow Up/Down - opens the menu, or moves the highlighted option while open
Home/End - jump to first/last enabled option while open
Enter/Space - open the menu, or toggle the highlighted option while open (the menu stays open)
Backspace - with the menu closed, removes the last selected value
Tab - move focus (closes the menu first)

motion: CSS transitions/animations: neutralised by the global prefers-reduced-motion rule

properties.name: value
properties.description: empty = placeholder (Select's geometry: 12px inside the border); selected = dismissible Chip s instances,  wrapping,  4px from the outer edge.

properties.name: state
properties.description: Same treatment as Select — colors,  focus/open glow (shadow / focus) and chevron copied from the audited Select set.

figma.structure: The field only,  like Select. selected: the chip padding in code is (32 − 24)/2 − 1px border = 3px — off the scale — so Figma uses 4px padding (spacing/2xs) with the border drawn over it (strokesIncludedInLayout off): chips land 4px from the outer edge,  exactly like code. The chevron is absolute,  12px inside the border,  like code's position: absolute; right: 12px.

value.reason: empty shows the placeholder,  selected shows chips — the field's two looks (owner-approved exception)
